ValidationRule.description: ERROR WILL BE GIVEN WHEN BELOW CONDITION WILL SATISFY 1.When a new account will be insert 2.When any of the field is blank linkedin, website or crunchb 2.When the user channel will be enterprise channel like EA , ME FS 3.When the user is not a admin
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISNEW() ,
OR(ISBLANK( Linkedin__c ) ,ISBLANK( Crunchbase__c ),ISBLANK( Website )),
OR(ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'ME FS') , ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'EA'),ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'SG FS'),ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'MY FS'),ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'PH FS'),ISPICKVAL($User.Channel__c , 'HK FS')) ,
$User.Profile_Name__c <> 'System Administrator' ,
$User.Profile_Name__c <> 'System Admin'
)
